name: rdt
author: leonrlr4
description: Your Reddit feed in the Omarchy bar, read with the session you are already signed in to in your browser. Unread count on the pill, posts and comments in the popup.

barWidget.description: Unread count on the bar; feeds, posts and comments in the popup.

schema.label: Feeds
schema.description: Comma separated. 'best' is your subscribed front page; anything else is a subreddit, e.g. best, r/omarchy, linux

schema.label: Background refresh (minutes)
schema.description: 0 fetches only when you open the panel — no background polling at all. Set 2 or more to keep the unread count live between opens.

schema.label: Browser
schema.description: Which browser's Reddit session to use. Leave empty to detect it automatically. One of: chromium, chrome, brave, vivaldi, edge

schema.label: Hide the pill when nothing is unread
Show thumbnails and post images
schema.description: Loads Reddit's downscaled renditions, not the originals. Turn off for a text-only panel.
